# Smash B — Ras Al Khaimah (smashb.ae)

> Smash B is a smash burger shop near American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK) in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. One outlet is currently open near AURAK, with a second branch in Al Dhait opening soon.

## Quick Facts
- **Name**: Smash B (سماش بي)
- **Cuisine**: Smash Burgers, Crispy Chicken Burgers, Loaded Fries, Sandwiches, Milkshakes, Mojitos, Fresh Juice
- **Address**: Near American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK), Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates (TODO: exact street/building & lat/long coordinates)
- **Branches**: 1 active outlet near AURAK, Ras Al Khaimah; Al Dhait (Ras Al Khaimah) coming soon
- **Operating Hours**: Daily, 1:00 PM – 12:00 AM (GST / UTC+4)
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +971 56 353 5819
- **Price Range**: AED 10 – AED 25 (Smash burgers start from AED 12)
- **Halal Status**: 100% Halal
- **Service & Ordering Options**: Dine-in, Takeaway, WhatsApp takeaway (+971 56 353 5819), Delivery across Ras Al Khaimah via Talabat (https://www.talabat.com/uae/smash-b)

## Best Sellers & Prices (AED)
- **Solo Smash** — AED 12: Potato bun, single beef patty, cheese, pickle, caramelized onion, SB sauce.
- **Duo Smash** — AED 17: Double beef patty, cheese, pickle, caramelized onion, SB sauce.
- **Trio Smash** — AED 23: Triple beef patty, cheese, pickle, caramelized onion, SB sauce.
- **Classic Crunch** — AED 12: Fried crispy chicken, jalapeno, iceberg lettuce, SB sauce.
- **Classic Spice** — AED 17: Fried crispy chicken, Nashville sauce, jalapeno, iceberg lettuce, SB sauce.
- **Crunch Bomb (Loaded Fries)** — AED 10: Fried chicken, french fries, jalapeno, SB sauce.
- **Beefy Bomb (Loaded Fries)** — AED 12: Smashed beef, french fries, pickle, SB sauce.
- **Fire Bomb (Loaded Fries)** — AED 15: Nashville chicken, french fries, jalapeno, SB sauce.
- **Havana (Sandwich)** — AED 13: French baguette, beef patty, roasted beef, mustard sauce, pickle, SB sauce.
- **Twisted Chick (Sandwich)** — AED 12: Tortilla wrap, fried chicken, lettuce, jalapeno, cheese, SB sauce.
- **Combo Add-On**: Soft drink + fries for +AED 6 with any burger or sandwich.
- **Milkshakes**: AED 12 – AED 13 (Mango Madness, Coco Crush, Lotus Loaded, Oreo Overload, Choco Melt, Smash Berry).
- **Mojitos**: AED 10 – AED 12 (Blue Wave, Pink Rush, Violet Vibe, Mint Rush, Passion Storm, Midnight Berry).
- **Fresh Juice**: Lemon Mint — AED 10.
